scope: actual Blender render vs reference RGB, no post-render registration or color correction

input_camera_fit.selection: SSIM of normalized official photo crops; no rendered image optimization
input_camera_fit.framing: input bbox fitted; no post-render registration

protocol.ssim: scikit-image Gaussian sigma=1.5, population covariance, 11x11 window; ROI eroded by 5px
protocol.roi: reference bbox + 2.5% margin; does not depend on prediction
protocol.camera: saved estimated affine projection; object-space realization in Blender, not physically calibrated
